svg.aria-label: The notation used in every diagram of the series. A solid dark arrow is a request, a dashed dark arrow its response, a teal arrow starting with a dot an unsolicited update or event, a blue arrow cyclic traffic, a solid copper arrow a control command and a dotted copper arrow a control acknowledgement. A red dotted line ending in a cross is a message that was lost. Below, the five patterns: A explicit request/response, B subscriptions and event reporting, C cyclic process-data exchange, D producer/consumer and group communication, E wide-area application messaging.
